//guardDuplicatesAgainstIncomingBetter: Default false: keep one best FINISHED copy available now for each movie, episode, or identical-range pack. Remove a redundant finished copy only when another finished copy is better or equal, retaining one keeper when equal. Never remove the last finished copy merely because a potentially better version is downloading: keep the current best until that download finishes, then compare the finished versions again. When true, incoming-better protection also delays redundant-copy cleanup; false allows cleanup against an already finished keeper. This setting affects rule 4, pack-vs-single and rule 4b; the separate unconditional DoVi and full-disc-rip exclusions are unchanged.
//titleAliases: One show, several spellings. Key = the title the parser produces, value = the title to file it under. Case-insensitive; chains are followed. Nothing is guessed: a title not listed here is untouched, because folding titles by similarity would trade a duplicate nobody notices for a wrong file deleted. See docs/RULES.md.
